name: +1 Speed Roller Escape
desc:
Welcome to +1 Speed Roller Escape! 🛼

How to Play:
🛼 Every roll makes you faster!
🏃 Dodge obstacles and reach the end to get wins!
⚡ Unlock new rollers that give insane speed boosts!
🔥 Rebirth to unlock powerful new perks!

If you’re having fun, don’t forget to like the game! 👍
